project.title: VoRD: Vocabulary of Restrictive Datasets
project.description: Vocabulary for describing operational restrictions of SPARQL services, aligned with SPARQL Service Description and validated with SHACL and ShEx.

nodes.label: Connection Number Restriction
nodes.comment: Restriction on number of simultaneous open connections or active query executions.

nodes.label: Cost Model
nodes.comment: Identifier for an implementation-specific cost model used by an endpoint.

nodes.label: Cost Model Restriction
nodes.comment: Restriction based on internal query optimizer or execution cost estimation.

nodes.label: Enforcement Mode
nodes.comment: Class of operational behaviors that apply when a restriction is reached. Standard enforcement mode terms in this vocabulary are additionally modeled as SKOS concepts, but the class itself is kept separate from skos:Concept.

nodes.label: Metric
nodes.comment: Class of measurable dimensions that a Restriction constrains. Standard metric terms in this vocabulary are additionally modeled as SKOS concepts, but the class itself is kept separate from skos:Concept.

nodes.label: Quota Restriction
nodes.comment: Rolling or fixed query submission quota over a longer period (day, week, month).

nodes.label: Rate Restriction
nodes.comment: Restriction on request frequency over time.

nodes.label: Timeout Restriction
nodes.comment: Maximum allowed execution or waiting time for a query.

nodes.label: Restriction
nodes.comment: A machine-readable operational restriction or policy threshold for a SPARQL endpoint.

nodes.label: Result Size Restriction
nodes.comment: Restriction on result payload size, bindings, or triples.

nodes.label: Scope
nodes.comment: Class of enforcement scopes at which a restriction is evaluated (e.g., per user, global). Standard scope terms in this vocabulary are additionally modeled as SKOS concepts, but the class itself is kept separate from skos:Concept.

nodes.label: Server Load Restriction
nodes.comment: Restriction activated by host or cluster load conditions.

nodes.label: cost model
nodes.comment: Cost model used to interpret an internal cost-model restriction.

nodes.label: enforcement
nodes.comment: Action taken when the restriction is reached.

nodes.label: has restriction
nodes.comment: Relates a SPARQL service to a restriction statement.

nodes.label: has scope
nodes.comment: Scope in which the restriction is enforced.

nodes.label: signals header
nodes.comment: HTTP header name used by the endpoint to signal this restriction status.

nodes.label: metric
nodes.comment: Metric constrained by this restriction.

nodes.label: unit
nodes.comment: Unit of measure for maxValue.

nodes.label: burst value
nodes.comment: Additional burst threshold for short spikes.

nodes.label: hard restriction
nodes.comment: True if the threshold is strictly enforced; false if advisory or load-dependent.

nodes.label: maximum value
nodes.comment: Primary threshold value for this restriction.

nodes.label: minimum value
nodes.comment: Optional minimum threshold for this restriction.

nodes.label: retry after hint
nodes.comment: Suggested waiting duration before retry (xsd:duration).

nodes.label: returns status code
nodes.comment: HTTP status code commonly used when this restriction is exceeded (e.g., 429).

nodes.label: window duration
nodes.comment: Duration window for evaluating this restriction (xsd:duration).

nodes.label: Degrade Quality
nodes.comment: The endpoint continues serving requests with reduced quality of service.

nodes.label: Estimated Cost Units
nodes.comment: Optimizer- or planner-estimated internal cost score for query execution.

nodes.label: Evaluation Time
nodes.comment: Integer amount of time a request is evaluated in seconds.

nodes.label: Global
nodes.comment: The restriction is shared across all traffic handled by the endpoint instance or cluster.

nodes.label: Per API Key
nodes.comment: The restriction is enforced independently for each API key credential.

nodes.label: Per Client IP
nodes.comment: The restriction is enforced independently for each client IP address.

nodes.label: Per Request
nodes.comment: The restriction is evaluated within a single incoming request or query execution.

nodes.label: Per User
nodes.comment: The restriction is enforced independently for each authenticated user identity.

nodes.label: Queue Request
nodes.comment: The endpoint queues requests instead of executing immediately when capacity is constrained.

nodes.label: Reject Request
nodes.comment: The endpoint rejects requests that violate the restriction.

nodes.label: Requests per Day
nodes.comment: Count of requests accumulated over a one-day quota period.

nodes.label: Requests per Window
nodes.comment: Count of requests observed within a configured sliding or fixed window.

nodes.label: Result Bindings
nodes.comment: Number of solution bindings (solution mappings) returned by a SPARQL query.

nodes.label: Throttle Response
nodes.comment: The endpoint slows processing or response delivery under limiting conditions.

nodes.label: Truncate Result
nodes.comment: The endpoint returns a partial result when the restriction is reached.

nodes.label: VoRD enforcement mode scheme
nodes.comment: Concept scheme for the controlled enforcement mode terms defined by VoRD.

nodes.label: VoRD metric scheme
nodes.comment: Concept scheme for the controlled metric terms defined by VoRD.

nodes.label: VoRD scope scheme
nodes.comment: Concept scheme for the controlled scope terms defined by VoRD.
